app.title: AgriSense AI
app.subtitle: Smart India Hackathon 2026
app.tagline: ET₀-Based Autonomous Precision Irrigation with ESP32 Edge Safety

steps.title: 1. The Challenge: Water Crisis in Agriculture
steps.description: Traditional fixed-interval irrigation wastes up to 45% of groundwater and risks pump coil burnouts during dry borewell spells.

steps.title: 2. Precision Field Zoning
steps.description: The 60×60m farm is partitioned into micro-zones: Wheat (Zone 1), Sugarcane (Zone 2), and Vegetables (Zone 3), each with individual drip manifolds.

steps.title: 3. Low-Cost IoT Sensor Nodes
steps.description: FC-28 capacitive probes, DHT22 ambient sensors, inline YF-S201 flow meters, and ACS712 current sensors capture telemetry every minute.

steps.title: 4. ESP32 Edge Gateway & Safety
steps.description: The IP65 field controller runs dual-core ESP32 firmware with local sub-second safety interlocks, SD card logging, and SIM800L cellular fallback.

steps.title: 5. MQTT Cloud Uplink
steps.description: Lightweight telemetry packets stream over MQTT to the cloud backend for real-time analytics and predictive irrigation modeling.

steps.title: 6. Cloud AI & ET₀ Decision Engine
steps.description: Calculates ET₀ via Hargreaves formula, factors in crop Kc and monsoon rain forecast, and generates optimal watering schedules.

steps.title: 7. Downlink Execution & Feedback Loop
steps.description: Actuation commands open solenoid valves and engage the motor contactor. Live sensor feedback verifies flow and soil absorption.

steps.title: 8. Fail-Safe Sub-second Protection
steps.description: Borewell dry-runs and line ruptures are isolated by the ESP32 in < 2 seconds without requiring cloud connectivity.

steps.title: 9. Impact & SDG Alignment
steps.description: AgriSense achieves 38% water savings and 36% energy reduction, directly advancing UN SDG 2 (Zero Hunger), SDG 6 (Clean Water), and SDG 12/13.
